title: Meet Daniel Janzen, the ecologist restoring 169,000 hectares of Costa Rica
summary_full: Daniel Janzen, a pioneering biologist, significantly advanced tropical ecosystem research and conservation initiatives. Through his innovative work in Costa Rica's Guanacaste Conservation Area, he fostered collaboration with local communities. For many years, Janzen scrutinised the intricate dynamics between flora and fauna, culminating in a large-scale conservation area and establishing a notable legacy in science that underscores the importance of ecosystem comprehension for ongoing protection.
